title: Diversity-Seeking Docking-Guided Molecular Design Discovers Broader Predicted Interaction Profiles across Protein Families.
journal: Journal of chemical information and modeling
one_liner_zh: 该文将分子对接引导的从头设计建模为多样性搜索问题，通过多交互指纹和多种策略比较，在多个蛋白家族上扩展了预测的相互作用谱，虽以配体设计为主，但其多样性感知搜索框架可迁移至蛋白质结构计算中的构象采样与生成任务。
abstract: Structure-based discovery pipelines commonly prioritize a scalar docking score, concentrating candidates into narrow chemotypes and contact patterns. We formulate docking-guided de novo molecular design as a diversity-seeking exploration problem and compare goal-directed, quality-diversity, Pareto-optimization, affinity-focused, novelty-based, and random search policies. Molecules are generated by fragment-based CReM edits and scored by rigid-receptor GNINA/Vina docking. We introduce a residue-level multi-interaction fingerprint encoding hydrophobic contacts and hydrogen-bond donor and acceptor interactions, together with the reachability ratio, an empirical diagnostic of goal-retrieval discriminability. Across seven targets from five protein families, with 500 docking evaluations per run, Curiosity-IMGEP discovers 15.0% more interaction profiles than random search (d = 1.01, pBonf < 10-6) and produces +12% more Bemis-Murcko scaffolds and +21% more binary residue-contact patterns. A newly added budget-matched NSGA-II baseline achieves the strongest predicted binding affinity in the benchmark (-11.03 vs Genetic algorithm's -10.98 kcal/mol; d = -1.02 vs Random, pBonf < 10-8), tied within noise with the Genetic algorithm, and leads on Bemis-Murcko scaffold count (23 +/- 12), but underperforms QD/goal-directed methods on interaction-profile counts (259 +/- 46, -12% vs Random). Representation ablations compare continuous and binary fingerprints, charged-interaction channels, distance cutoffs, and inclusion of docking quality in the search vector. Target-specific ChEMBL neighborhood and pose-robustness analyses provide orthogonal computational triage. The results establish that diversity-aware search broadens the set of docking-predicted interaction hypotheses generated under a fixed budget; they do not experimentally establish distinct binding modes or biochemical activity. Code, configurations, and raw results are publicly available.
abstract_zh: 基于结构的发现流程通常优先考虑标量对接分数，将候选分子集中于狭窄的化学型和接触模式。我们将对接引导的从头分子设计表述为一种多样性寻求的探索问题，并比较目标导向、质量-多样性、帕累托优化、亲和力聚焦、基于新颖性和随机搜索策略。分子通过基于片段的CReM编辑生成，并通过刚性受体GNINA/Vina对接进行评分。我们引入了一种残基级多相互作用指纹，编码疏水接触以及氢键供体和受体相互作用，同时引入可达性比率，这是一种目标检索可区分性的经验诊断指标。在来自五个蛋白质家族的七个靶标上，每次运行进行500次对接评估，Curiosity-IMGEP发现的相互作用谱比随机搜索多15.0%（d = 1.01，pBonf < 10-6），并产生多12%的Bemis-Murcko骨架和多21%的二元残基接触模式。新加入的预算匹配NSGA-II基线在基准中实现了最强的预测结合亲和力（-11.03 vs 遗传算法的-10.98 kcal/mol；d = -1.02 vs 随机，pBonf < 10-8），与遗传算法在噪声范围内持平，并在Bemis-Murcko骨架计数上领先（23 +/- 12），但在相互作用谱计数上表现不及QD/目标导向方法（259 +/- 46，-12% vs 随机）。表征消融比较了连续和二元指纹、带电相互作用通道、距离截断以及将对接质量纳入搜索向量。靶标特异性ChEMBL邻域和位姿稳健性分析提供了正交的计算筛选。结果确立，多样性感知搜索在固定预算下拓宽了对接预测的相互作用假设集合；它们并未通过实验确立不同的结合模式或生化活性。代码、配置和原始结果已公开可用。
